description: This file defines the HandlerList class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It manages a list of middleware functions and a primary handler, organizing the execution order for AWS request handling, including support for middleware stacking, ordering, and interposition. The class supports different middleware steps (init, validate, build, sign, attempt) and enables dynamic modification of the middleware queue.

classes.name: HandlerList
classes.description: Manages a list of middleware functions and a handler for AWS SDK request processing, supporting middleware ordering, interposition, and dynamic modification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HandlerList with an optional HTTP handler.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the middleware list and handler.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Sets the primary handler function that returns a response.

methods.name: hasHandler
methods.description: Checks if the handler has been set.

methods.name: appendInit
methods.description: Appends middleware to the init step.

methods.name: prependInit
methods.description: Prepends middleware to the init step.

methods.name: appendValidate
methods.description: Appends middleware to the validate step.

methods.name: prependValidate
methods.description: Prepends middleware to the validate step.

methods.name: appendBuild
methods.description: Appends middleware to the build step.

methods.name: prependBuild
methods.description: Prepends middleware to the build step.

methods.name: appendSign
methods.description: Appends middleware to the sign step.

methods.name: prependSign
methods.description: Prepends middleware to the sign step.

methods.name: appendAttempt
methods.description: Appends middleware to the attempt step.

methods.name: prependAttempt
methods.description: Prepends middleware to the attempt step.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Adds middleware before a specific middleware by name.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Adds middleware after a specific middleware by name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a middleware by name or instance.

methods.name: interpose
methods.description: Sets an interposing function to modify middleware invocation sequence.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Composes the middleware and handler into a single callable.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total count of middleware functions in all steps.

methods.name: splice
methods.description: Internal method to insert middleware before or after a specific middleware.

methods.name: debugCallable
methods.description: Provides a string description of a callable for debugging purposes.

methods.name: sortMiddleware
methods.description: Sorts middleware, applying interpose functions if set.

methods.name: removeByName
methods.description: Removes middleware by name from the list.

methods.name: removeByInstance
methods.description: Removes middleware by its callable instance.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Internal method to add middleware to a specific step, optionally at the beginning.
